A key supplied to any method may be a single hashable object, a list, or a set; lists retain order, sets are normalized by ascending `repr`, and a scalar becomes a one-item tuple. Values supplied to `add` or `remove` may likewise be a scalar, list, or set and are treated as a collection of values. Empty lists and sets are valid. Unhashable elements raise `TypeError` without modifying state. Implement `add(key, values)`, `add_empty(key)`, `remove(key, values)`, `get(key)`, and `reset_dirty()`. `add` and `remove` return whether membership changed; `add_empty` returns whether a bucket was created. Any actual creation, addition, or removal sets `dirty=True`; no-op operations do not. `get` returns an immutable `frozenset` snapshot and returns an empty one for an absent key. `reset_dirty` only clears the flag. `str(instance)` must list buckets ordered by `repr(key)`, one per line as `KEY: VALUE_REPRS`, with values ordered by `repr`; an empty object renders as an empty string. Returned objects must not alias internal mutable sets.

import unittest

from solution import RelationBuckets


class RelationBucketsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_get_remove_and_dirty_transitions(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("missing"), frozenset())
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)

        self.assertTrue(buckets.add("k", [3, 1, 3]))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({1, 3}))

        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add("k", {1, 3}))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add("k", 2))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)

        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.remove("k", [9]))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertTrue(buckets.remove("k", [1, 9]))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({2, 3}))

    def test_key_normalization_for_lists_sets_and_scalars(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add(["a", "b"], "list-key")
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["a", "b"]), frozenset({"list-key"}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["b", "a"]), frozenset())

        buckets.add({2, 10}, "set-key")
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get((10, 2)), frozenset({"set-key"}))

        tuple_scalar = ("x", "y")
        buckets.add(tuple_scalar, "tuple-value")
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(tuple_scalar), frozenset({"tuple-value"}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get(["x", "y"]), frozenset())

    def test_value_tuple_is_a_scalar_hashable_value(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        value = (1, 2)
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add("k", value))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({value}))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.remove("k", value))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset())

    def test_add_empty_and_empty_collection_no_ops(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertTrue(buckets.add_empty("empty"))
        self.assertTrue(buckets.dirty)
        buckets.reset_dirty()
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add_empty("empty"))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.add("empty", []))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.remove("empty", set()))
        self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("empty"), frozenset())

    def test_get_returns_immutable_snapshot(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("k", [1, 2])
        snapshot = buckets.get("k")
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, frozenset)
        buckets.add("k", 3)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, frozenset({1, 2}))
        self.assertEqual(buckets.get("k"), frozenset({1, 2, 3}))

    def test_unhashable_elements_fail_transactionally(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        buckets.add("existing", 1)
        buckets.reset_dirty()

        calls = [
            lambda: buckets.add(["new", []], 2),
            lambda: buckets.add("new", [2, []]),
            lambda: buckets.remove("existing", [1, {}]),
            lambda: buckets.get(["existing", {}]),
            lambda: buckets.add_empty({"bad": "key"}),
        ]
        for call in calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    call()
                self.assertEqual(buckets.get("existing"), frozenset({1}))
                self.assertEqual(buckets.get("new"), frozenset())
                self.assertFalse(buckets.dirty)

    def test_string_rendering_is_deterministic(self):
        buckets = RelationBuckets()
        self.assertEqual(str(buckets), "")
        buckets.add("z", {3, 1, 2})
        buckets.add("a", {"z", "a"})
        self.assertEqual(
            str(buckets),
            "('a',): 'a', 'z'\n('z',): 1, 2, 3",
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
